name: Akebonobashi
tagline: Shinjuku in 5 minutes and Shibuya in 15 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 15 minutes to Otemachi, 5 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 33 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. The station stands 19.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.8 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 19.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 19.7 m to 33.5 m, a difference of 13.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 12 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東京女子医科大学病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 鉄友会柳町病院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Shinjuku Line.
congestion: Toei Shinjuku Line runs at 152% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 西大島→住吉, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000 and 2LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Yotsuya-Sanchome; for quiet, Akebonobashi.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Akebonobashi. Akebonobashi adds the Toei Shinjuku Line; Yotsuya-Sanchome adds the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line. Yotsuya-Sanchome is at least 8 minutes quicker to Tokyo and Toranomon. A one-room flat also costs about ¥5,000 less at Yotsuya-Sanchome. On quiet, though, Akebonobashi comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Ushigome-Yanagicho; for how close the centre is, Akebonobashi.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Akebonobashi. Akebonobashi adds the Toei Shinjuku Line; Ushigome-Yanagicho adds the Toei Oedo Line. Akebonobashi is at least 5 minutes quicker to Toranomon and Shinagawa. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥16,000 less at Ushigome-Yanagicho.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 靖国通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Shinjuku Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Mornings here are less crowded than the line figures suggest: the lines are busy, but this station is outside their busiest stretches.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
